title: Content Writer
description:
Content Writer Experience: 1-3 Years We are looking for a Content Writer to join our team! As a contend Writer, you will be responsible for producing high-quality and understandable IT field-related content for websites, blogs, social media, whitepapers, ebooks, and many other platforms. Able to design catchy taglines, luring blogs, well-drafted articles, must have a knack for storytelling. Responsible for developing content for websites & marketing collateral. Will have to handle the web & print & web content management & update. Ability to write webpage content, creative ideas for writing. Understanding branding & writing for the online industry, the candidate will be responsible for executing the companys social media program to include content creation and social monitoring to expand the companys presence in the online & media community. Content development whenever required as a part of SMO services. Managing profiles and pages on social networking sites including Facebook, Twitter, Linked In, and other community sites. Posting content on relevant blogs/forums and seeding content into social applications as and when needed. Job Type: Full-time. Full Stack PHP Developers Experience: 1-4 + Years We are looking for Full Stack PHP Developers who are ready to take their career to the next level and who have strong technical concepts, and are ready to work in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment. Able to core PHP, Laravel, WordPress, Cakestrong knowledge of PHP web frameworks. Understanding the fully synchronous behavior of PHP. Understanding of MVC design patterns. Basic understanding of front-end technologies, such as JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3. Knowledge of object-oriented PHP programming. Extensive knowledge of the MERN stack. Experience working with HTML5, CSS, Bootstrap 3/4 is required. Strong experience with MySQL Database design and management. Solid working knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and MVC. Experience developing and consuming Restful APIs. Understanding of various Data formats such as XML, JSON, and CSV. Strong knowledge of user authentication and authorization between multiple systems. Proficient understanding of source control and code versioning tools (Git / Bitbucket). Familiarity with performance and scalability issues and solutions. Experience with setting up and configuring web servers (Apache, IIS, and others). Knowledge of application security best practices and secure. Quality Analyst Minimum 2-3 years of experience Role & Responsibility: We are looking for experienced manual tester having 2-3 years of experience. Candidate must have following technical and non-technical skills: Good understanding of testing concepts and terminologies used. Able to create a test plan and test case documents. Execute test cases for all phases of the testing process. Report defects/bugs in a timely manner. Past experience in testing web application and doing compatibility testing across browsers and devices. Perform thorough regression testing when bugs are resolved. Basic understanding of programming languages concepts. Ability to coordinate with multiple teams on different assigned tasks. Good analytical and problem solving skills. Should be a good team player. Should have worked in Agile Development Model. Excellent communication skills Rust Blockchain Developer Experience: 2-5 Years Responsibilities: Execute software development life cycle. Produce specifications and determine operational feasibility. Develop flowcharts, layouts and documentation to identify requirements and solutions. Building out the smart contracts on rust and solidity/Vyper. Demonstrated ability to learn new tech and write secure and high-quality code. Integrate software components into a fully functional software system. Document and maintain software functionality. Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade existing systems. Deploy programs and evaluate user feedback. Requirements and skills: Work experience as a Software Engineer or Software Developer. 1+ years of experience working on blockchain-based projects, DeFi, and Cryptonomicon protocol design. Experience writing smart contracts on Solana is a must. Ability to develop software in Rust, Node.js, React JS. Build web3 applications and services. Interface and interact with web3 applications (web3.js / RPC API). Self-driven & asks for help or assistance when needed. Proficiency in software engineering tools. Ability to document requirements and specifications. Experience on the Solana Ecosystem. If you cant find a job profile that matches your skills, feel free to apply anyway, as we have other openings not listed here.
